profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Muse App / Meta Superintelligence Labs
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer @ Meta Superintelligence Labs
profile.summary:
I write code and stuff, and it’s pretty fun.

I currently work at Meta (fka Facebook) as a Software Engineer.

My other experiences include;
- Flipp, one of the most popular shopping apps with 10+ million installs on the Play Store.
- Hypercare, a healthcare startup focused on providing secure communications and coordination tools to over 60 healthcare organizations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer @ Meta Superintelligence Labs
positions.description:
🧠 Muse App (2026-) → Part of the core Android team (team of 5 including myself). Built the agentic shopping and checkout experiences.

🤖 Meta AI (2025-2026) → Crafting intuitive experiences for Meta AI.
- Most recently worked on Shopping Agent, several rich features as part of the Muse Spark launch, Vibes and other assistant experiences.
- Owned the Meta AI chat experience on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and Facebook and was responsible for bringing frontier AI experiences to parity with our standalone app.

💬 Conversation Starters (2024-2025) → IC lead accelerating multiple initiatives with significant engagement wins across 5 separate products within Messenger; Inbox Tray, Stories, Notes, Active Now and Friends Tab.

💭 Messenger Notes (2024-2024) → Led the team responsible for ephemeral and lightweight status updates from your friends and family on Messenger.

📣 Instagram Channels (2022-2024) → Launched Broadcast Channels, taking it from 0-1. In particular:
- Tech Lead for the engagement team, responsible for multiple features such as Prompts, Polls and Custom Reactions.
- Leading and executing on infra scaling efforts to be able to handle accounts with 500M+ followers like Cristiano Ronaldo
- Spun up a growth workstream; ideating, designing and leading several growth features to reach PMF and grow DAU numbers into 100M+ DAU with strong retention.

👥 Messenger Groups (2021-2022) → Creating fun and engaging group chat features. Some examples of features I led and launched:
- Group Typing Indicators (i.e. the bubble that pops up when you see people typing)
- Pinned Messages
- Invite Links for Community Chats

💸 Instagram Ads (2020-2021) → Enhancing Feed & Stories ads experiences, increasing revenue by $XXM

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Went to build the “WhatsApp for healthcare” while finishing my last year of university.

🤖 As the sole Android engineer, I worked directly with the CEO and CTO, rewriting the app from the ground up, providing fast and HIPAA-compliant messaging to over 60 organizations (as well as reducing the amount of crashes to near zero)

🎉 I was also fortunate enough to be there when we secured over $2M USD in seed funding from Foothill Ventures, Ramen Ventures and Wavemaker 360!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Did Android stuff...

🐞 Squashed several bugs!

🚀 Launched multiple major features (e.g. UI refresh, ratings review card and item merchandising feed), leading to increased engagement and revenue.
